{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper_length_mm
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean for each species with full precision
for species, mean_length in mean_flipper_by_species.items():
    print(f"The mean flipper length for {species} is {mean_length:.6f} mm.")

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f"{highest_species} has the highest mean flipper length.")"}
